Hello RC-DE Team,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0396923 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2
) to the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
We have found the following error flags:
DoorPositionSwitch_BG3_BG4 & SafetyRelay_QA26
Please refer KA for
SafetyRelay_QA26 Error:
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SID_HW_QA26_MCCB failure in feedback line
We need to schedule a site visit to check whether the BG3 and BG4 switches are properly secured in place or if they have become loose. If they are loose, they should be fixed.
If the switches are securely in place, we need to check if they are functioning correctly. If they are not, spare parts should be available for replacement.
If the switches are working fine, we will proceed with further troubleshooting according to the schematic.
We must also ensure that the connections at XD34, XD9.1, and XD9.2 are secure.
